title: Editorial Expression of Concern: Functional connectivity signatures of political ideology
content: PNAS Nexus is publishing an Editorial Expression of Concern regarding the following article: Seo Eun Yang, James D Wilson, Zhong-Lin Lu, Skyler Cranmer, Functional connectivity signatures of political ideology, PNAS Nexus, Volume 1, Issue 3, July 2022, pgac066, https://doi.org/10.1093/pnasnexus/pgac066.
